# NavMenu

The vertical navigation of an app or dashboard: links with icons, groups that open, the current page marked.

```tsx
import { NavMenu } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- As the sidebar of the Altazor CRM or any app with more than five destinations.
- Two levels at most: a group and its pages.
- `onNavigate` for single-page apps; without it the links work as ordinary links.

## When not to

- The top navigation of a reading site: use plain links in a header.
- Deeper than two levels.
- Using it for steps (Stepper) or sections of one page (TableOfContents).

## Examples

### Side navigation

Real links: `href` is required on every item that goes somewhere, and `value` marks the current one with `aria-current="page"`. `onNavigate` lets a single-page app handle the click itself; Ctrl, Cmd and middle clicks still open the link normally. A parent with `children` is a button that opens its group; it opens by itself when the current page is inside it.

```tsx
<Demo start="narrativa" />
```

### Collapsed

`collapsed` shows only the icons. Names stay in the page for screen readers, and a native tooltip shows the name on hover. Use it for flat menus: a parent without its own `href` has nowhere to go when collapsed, so it is left out.

```tsx
<Demo collapsed />
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` (required) | `NavMenuItem[]` |  |  |
| `value` (required) | `string` |  | The `key` of the current page. |
| `onNavigate` | `(key: string) => void` |  | Lets a single-page app handle the click. Ctrl, Cmd, Shift and middle clicks are left to the browser. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Names the landmark. Defaults to "Navegación principal"; give each one a different name when the page has more than one. |
| `collapsed` | `boolean` | `false` | Icons only. The names stay in the page for screen readers and appear as a tooltip. A group without its own `href` is left out. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **A `nav` landmark** named by `label`; give each one a different name if the page has more than one.
- **Real links.** The current page has `aria-current="page"`, a stronger fill and a brand-coloured marker on the left, so it is not only a colour.
- **Groups are disclosure buttons** with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; Enter and Space open and close them. Tab visits every link in order; there is no roving focus to learn.
- Items are 44 px high. A disabled item is plain text with `aria-disabled`, outside the Tab order.
- **Collapsed:** the names remain in the page for screen readers and become a tooltip for the eye.

## Content

- One or two words per item, nouns for places ("Personas"), not verbs.
